title: VibeGraph quality layer: the check grammar
description: The verbs a checkable half may use: the M-GRAMMAR verbs in constraint_grammar.ts (callers-only, import-only, calls-through, and payload-keys, added 2026-09-28 in src/server/payload_check.ts) and the five Run 1 forced into existence (guards, not-in-loop, handles-failure, annotated, co-changes; reviews/quality-layer/RUN1.md section 3). Operand shapes only. Decision procedures are specified in RUN1.md and implemented in Run 3. A malformed check is refused at the boundary, never coerced (constraint_store.ts precedent).

allowTests.description: 2026-10-01: every test file is also an allowed place (src/shared/path_match.ts isTestFile). A files entry may be a folder (trailing /) or a glob.
2026-10-01: every test file may import it too. A files entry may be a folder (trailing /) or a glob.

PayloadKeys.description: Every call to target spells the required key paths and none of the forbidden ones, read from the literal arguments at each call site (the IR node's argKeys). A path is `key` or `key.inner`. A key hidden by a spread, a computed key or a non-literal value makes that site unverifiable, never violated. Values are never read.

Guards.description: RUN1 3.1. Every call to target is governed by a call to guard: the guard sits in an if-test whose arm contains the target call, or precedes it in the same or an enclosing block with no return between. Stricter than calls-through, which stays for co-occurrence.

NotInLoop.description: RUN1 3.2. No call attributed to target (a name) or to a tool with role sits inside a loop container reached by the thread. At least one of target or role. except names project funnels whose bodies are judged on their own.

HandlesFailure.description: RUN1 3.3. Every except/catch arm reached by the thread contains a raise, a return, or a call attributed to the log role or a funnel wrapping it.

scope.description: thread: the arms the thread reaches. files: every arm in the packet edit scope (or a whole tree for calibration).

Annotated.description: RUN1 3.4. The named parameters carry a type. entry-point: the packet's entry function's parameters. dynamic-receivers: parameters whose receiver calls the thread reports dynamic.

CoChanges.description: RUN1 3.5. If the run's combined delta changes `when`, it must also change `require`. Evaluated over server-collected deltas; a packet reviewed before the requiring packet ran is unverifiable (not-yet), never violated.
